summary: The Block Blast APK is the official Android installer for Block Blast!, HungryStudio's block puzzle where you fit shapes on an 8x8 board to clear rows and columns. The latest version is 11.0.5, updated November 24, 2026, and it needs Android 7.1 or newer. It's free, works offline and shows ads.
metaDescription: Block Blast APK download for Android: get the official Block Blast! 11.0.5 from Google Play, with high-score tips, how to reduce ads and install steps.

faq.q: Is Block Blast safe to play?
faq.a: Yes. The official Block Blast! from Google Play, published by HungryStudio, is safe and rated Everyone. It shows ads and sells optional purchases such as ad removal.

faq.q: Can I get Block Blast without ads?
faq.a: HungryStudio sells an in-app purchase to remove ads. Playing offline also reduces ads, though some features need a connection. Altered ad-free copies on other sites aren't official and can carry malware.

faq.q: Why is Block Blast so addictive?
faq.a: Rounds are short, there's no timer, and clearing several lines at once gives satisfying combos. Try setting a time limit with Android's Digital Wellbeing if you lose track of time.

faq.q: Can I play Block Blast offline?
faq.a: Yes. Block Blast works without internet, which makes it popular on flights and commutes.
